Game Overview

MotoBots 1 is a adventure title where race through the cosmos as a Martian robot in MotoBots 1, an infinite runner full of high-speed excitement. Dodge obstacles, collect power-ups, and aim to outlast your competition in an engaging retro arcade atmosphere. Keep your wits sharp and your Bot mobile to conquer the infinite challenge.
